entry.name: thispoly~
entry.description: Use the thispoly~ object to control poly~ voice allocation and muting. When placed inside a patcher loaded by the poly~ object, it sends and receives messages from the poly~ object that loads it.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Report the instance number of the patch
messages.description: Reports the instance number of the patch. The first instance is reported as.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Enable the "busy" state for the patcher instance
messages.description: Toggles the "busy" state for the patcher instance when the messageis received. The object will not receive messages generated by aormessage to the left inlet of the parentobject when the "busy" state is on.

messages.name: mute
messages.digest: Disable DSP processing for the patcher instance
messages.description: Disables DSP processing for the loaded instance of the patcher when the messageis received. This message can be combined with anmessage which toggles the "busy" state of the patcher to create voices in a patcher which are only on while they play a "note".

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Set the "busy" state of the patcher instance
messages.description: Sets the "busy" state of the patcher instance. The busy state for the patcher instance is set to 1 when theobject receives a non-zero input signal. The busy state is set to 0 otherwise.

inlets.digest: bang Reports Index and Mute, int Sets Voice Busy
